description: This file contains helper functions for generating GN build configuration snippets, including architecture name mappings and toolchain file creation, specific to the build environment and target architecture.

methods.name: gn_host_arch_name
methods.description: Returns a GN architecture name based on the build host's architecture string.

methods.name: gn_target_arch_name
methods.description: Returns a GN architecture name based on the target architecture variable.

methods.name: clang_install_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the clang compiler installation directory.

methods.name: write_toolchain_file
methods.description: Generates a GN toolchain configuration file with native and target toolchain settings.
